exposure: Insulin treatment for Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM)
Metformin treatment for Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM)
outcome: Neonatal complications (hypoglycaemia, NICU admission, respiratory distress)
cohort: 106 pregnant women diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus.
finding: While insulin and metformin provided similar glycemic control in women with GDM, metformin was associated with significantly fewer neonatal complications (hypoglycaemia, NICU admission, respiratory distress) and lower neonatal birth weight.
birth_weight: Measured; lower in the metformin group compared to the insulin group.
